check_torch_version_gte: check if the installed PyTorch version is greater than or equal to a given major.minor version
get_torch_version_constant: get the parsed PyTorch version as a packaging.version.Version object from the TORCH_VERSION constant
parse_torch_version: parse the torch.__version__ string into a Version object using the internal _get_torch_version function
review_torch_greater_or_equal: review the torch_greater_or_equal function to understand how it compares major and minor version numbers
summarize_version_utils: summarize the fairseq2 utils version module that provides PyTorch version checking utilities
